draft_text: Nimbrake seems to offer somewhat higher throughput than Caskline on Driftbay-Serve, although this is only a tentative reading of the 142 versus 119 requests-per-second measurements.
revised_text: Nimbrake measured 142 requests per second and Caskline 119 requests per second on Driftbay-Serve, but these figures are not directly comparable because Nimbrake used batch size 32 and Caskline used batch size 16.
rationale: Numbers 142 and 119 match T1. However, the table note states the figures are not directly comparable (different batch sizes), so the claim that Nimbrake "offers somewhat higher throughput" overstates comparability. The tentative hedge is appropriate but the comparison itself is undermined by the non-comparable settings.
